value.rationale: For the second-smallest nonabelian simple group, a canonical proper-subgroup order complex with nonzero first homology (minimal simple group result cited by Ramras) becomes collapsible under inner conjugation. Exact 3-dimensional orbit structure and its 49 collapses constitute a natural complete topological classification, contrasting A5 and S5 and detecting more than Euler characteristic or rational acyclicity; the claim does not require a general classification.
